replies.author: @Beyondhorizon-n6t
replies.text: Thank you for your comment! It is quite remarkable to consider how Ireland has transitioned from a history of widespread emigration to becoming a place of rapid population growth in recent years. I am so grateful you took the time to watch the film and share your reflections on where the country stands today.

replies.author: @Beyondhorizon-n6t
replies.text: I deeply appreciate your perspective, and I always value hearing from our community. When mentioning the current political borders in the video, my intention was never to diminish the profound, shared cultural identity and history that connects the people across the entire island. I completely understand how those geographic distinctions can feel dismissive of Ireland's rich heritage. It is a deeply complex and emotional history, and I am very grateful to have passionate, knowledgeable viewers like yourself adding important context to the conversation.
